text:
Maria: Quick heads up — we need final social plan for the May 6 webinar (benchmark + launch narrative). X and LinkedIn priority. Who can own post copy + assets?

Lucas: I can draft thread + X copies. Need hero GIF, 1200x628 and 800x800, and a 30s clip.

Ben: I'll provide landing UTMs and 2 CTA variants. Recommend utm_campaign=may6-webinar_bench utm_source=x|linkedin utm_medium=social.

Emily: Scheduler ready. Once Maria gives ✅ I'll queue posts and enable tracking. Need final copy by Tue 5pm PT.

Ravi: SDR routing — I can own replies for 1h after each post. Please set webhook to #inbound-sdr and include utm_term=webinar_signup in links.

Lucas: Draft schedule (UTC):
```
2026-05-06 12:00 — LinkedIn post (hero image)
2026-05-06 12:05 — X short post + thread
2026-05-06 15:00 — X repost: thread highlight
```
Copy draft below.

Maria: Copy looks good. Two asks: (1) pin a benchmark stat in first tweet, (2) softer language — replace 'free' with 'no-cost' per legal.

Ben: CTA variants:
- Register now — seats limited
- Join live + get benchmark PDF
UTM example: https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_campaign=may6-webinar_bench&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_content=cta1

Emily: I'll set scheduling windows and add a boosted promo slot for LinkedIn at 12:30 if approved.

LaunchBot: Calendar event created: "May 6 Webinar — Social Push" owner Maria, reminders set. :calendar:

Ravi: Also routing note — can we have a short canned response for high-intent replies with Calendly link? I'll draft the script.

Lucas: Dropping thread and X copy drafts:
1) LinkedIn long thread: "Benchmark shows 3x throughput with smart routing & batching. We'll break down the numbers on May 6 — register to get the full report."
2) X main: "Benchmark reveals 3x throughput w/ smart batching. Join our webinar to see the numbers. Register: <link>"
3) X thread first tweet: "New benchmark: same model, 40% lower per-token cost. Why? Join our May 6 webinar."

Maria: Good start. Lucas — move 'Register' CTA to end of thread; ping me when done. Also attach hero GIF and clip to this thread.

Lucas: Uploaded hero_gif_v3.gif and clip_30s.mp4 to the thread. Also updated copy (replaced 'free' w/ 'no-cost').

Emily: Queued posts in Scheduler (pending approval). Preview links: https://scheduler.redwood/preview/2345 (LinkedIn) https://scheduler.redwood/preview/2346 (X).

Maria: Approved. Go live and set monitoring to #marketing-watch for 2 hours post-launch. :rocket:

Ravi: SDRs ready. I'll push a summary to #inbound-sdr with reply script 10 min before first post.

Ben: Final note — I'll send UTMs and conversion tags to analytics after publish and flag any UTM mismatches.

Emily: Confirmed. Will flip on engagement alerts and tag the posts with campaign=may6-webinar_bench.

Maria: Thanks team — looks like we're set. Will check performance 30 min after first post and share highlights in this thread.
